submission.justification: No project document gives GWP100 values, so the hard GWP limit of 150 could not be verified for any candidate. I chose G1 because it is the only one built on newer replacement gases, which are the most likely to meet the limit. G2 is the standard fluorinated mixture and G3 only partly substitutes the fluorinated component, so both probably exceed 150. G2 and G3 have better time resolution in the 2025 summary (0.9 ns and 1.3 ns, against 2.0 ns for G1), but they are likely non-compliant. I simulated G1 at 1, 2 and 3 mm and got 2.27, 2.03 and 2.36 ns, so 2 mm is the best of those three gaps. The GWP of G1 must be confirmed before this choice is final.

requirements.requirement: Mixture is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: No document gives GWP values. G1 is only presumed compliant because it uses newer replacement gases. G2 and G3 are presumed non-compliant.

G1 at 2 mm gives 2.03 ns, the best of the gaps simulated (1 mm: 2.27 ns, 3 mm: 2.36 ns). G2 and G3 resolve better but their GWP compliance is not established, so G1 may not be the best compliant option.
